note: Frozen rules for the main judgment. Copied from rules.draft.json and changed only where docs/measurement/사전등록_v1.md decided (change log 11/16, 11/19, 11/24). rules.draft.json stays as the draft that the v2 simulation (result_v2.json), tests and demo sample were run with. Frozen before the AI judge sheet was coded and before the main results were computed.
_frozen_from: Changes from rules.draft.json: method anchors -> fixed (fixed_70 chosen by v2, 11/19); cell_keys drop service (services pooled, 11/16 and section 6); reference_kinds adds use (D6, 11/24); sensitivity: fixed_70 removed (now main), anchors_95 added (v2 candidate 'main').
_cell_keys: Pooled judgment (사전등록 v1 section 6, change log 11/16): services are merged, so the cell is feature x kind. Platform cells are reference only (platform_reference).
_platform_reference: Also report per-platform cells as reference only, for platforms with at least min_humans respondents. Not counted in the verdict summary.
_gate_fixed_70: Floor check first, then fixed 70%/50% on pooled values. Definition fixed in docs/measurement/사전등록_v1.md section 2.
_main_dist: main plus distribution similarity (1 - Jensen-Shannon divergence, base 2) on reason counts. Stratified permutation test (platform as block, all humans vs all AI personas): p >= 0.05 for dist. Added in docs/measurement/사전등록_v1.1_추가.md.
_main_rank: main plus rank agreement (Spearman, average ranks for ties) on reason counts. Same permutation test with rank as the statistic. Added in docs/measurement/사전등록_v1.1_추가.md.
_ladder_50: Decoy ladder. Decoy AIs are built from the cell's own human answers (50% wrong reasons, common reasons only, reversed order) plus the same AI's answers to other features. Trust needs both: no evidence the AI differs from humans (stratified permutation, min-p over four metrics, p >= 0.05) and the AI clearly beats every must_beat decoy (p < 0.05). Needs the codebook for common codes. Added in docs/measurement/사전등록_v1.2_추가.md.
_ladder: Draws per decoy kind (permutations use resamples). rungs: also report the 25/50/75% wrong-reason decoys. Report only, verdicts do not change.
_coverage_target: Report only. Sample coverage per cell (Chao et al. 2014, incidence data) and respondents needed to reach this coverage.
_human_equivalent: Report only. How many humans the AI sample is worth in distribution similarity. 0 draws turns it off.
_method: fixed_70 chosen by the v2 simulation (사전등록 v1 change log 11/19): both precision and recall >= trust -> trust, both >= reference -> reference. T=90 per service; pooled minimum 80.
_reference_kinds: Cells of these kinds are computed and printed separately but not counted in the verdict summary. use added 11/24 (Kang Sunwoo, PR #54 comment, D6): v2 simulated nouse cells only, and AI first impressions differ from 4-4 experience.
_reason_min_humans: 1, decided 11/24 (Kang Sunwoo, PR #54 comment). Only marks the reasons table.
_anchors_95: The v2 candidate named 'main' (two anchors, 95%). Reported as sensitivity after fixed_70 became main.
